Row.Text: "He who learns but does not think is lost. He who thinks but does not learn is endangered."
"Of all the things in the world, humanity is the most precious."
"A miserly father always has a wastrel son; an intelligent wife, a stupid husband. This is the way of things, so I laugh by myself. But nobody knows."
"The ruler sees his subjects as his hands and feet. The subjects see him as their head."
